description: This file contains the implementation of filtering components for FooTable, a jQuery plugin for enhancing HTML tables with filtering capabilities, including classes, methods, and event handling related to filtering, queries, and column filtering.

classes.name: FooTable.Filter
classes.description: Represents a filter with query, columns, and matching logic.

classes.name: FooTable.Filtering
classes.description: Component that adds filtering UI and logic to FooTable.

classes.name: FooTable.Query
classes.description: Represents and parses a search query for filtering.

methods.name: FooTable.Filter.prototype.match
methods.description: Checks if a string matches the filter's query.

methods.name: FooTable.Filter.prototype.matchRow
methods.description: Checks if a row matches the filter.

methods.name: FooTable.Filtering.prototype.preinit
methods.description: Prepares filtering component with options before initialization.

methods.name: FooTable.Filtering.prototype.init
methods.description: Initializes the filtering UI and event handlers.

methods.name: FooTable.Filtering.prototype.destroy
methods.description: Removes filtering UI and cleans up.

methods.name: FooTable.Filtering.prototype.$create
methods.description: Creates filtering UI elements.

methods.name: FooTable.Filtering.prototype.predraw
methods.description: Filters rows before they are drawn.

methods.name: FooTable.Filtering.prototype.draw
methods.description: Updates UI elements during draw.

methods.name: FooTable.Filtering.prototype.filter
methods.description: Applies filters to rows.

methods.name: FooTable.Filtering.prototype.clear
methods.description: Clears current filters.

methods.name: FooTable.Filtering.prototype.setButton
methods.description: Updates filter button icon.

methods.name: FooTable.Filtering.prototype.find
methods.description: Finds a filter by name.

methods.name: FooTable.Filtering.prototype.columns
methods.description: Gets columns for filtering.

methods.name: FooTable.Filtering.prototype.ensure
methods.description: Ensures array contains only FooTable.Filter objects.

methods.name: FooTable.Filtering.prototype.createFilter
methods.description: Creates a new filter object.

methods.name: FooTable.Query.prototype.val
methods.description: Gets or sets the query string, parsing on set.

methods.name: FooTable.Query.prototype.match
methods.description: Tests if a string matches the query.

methods.name: FooTable.Query.prototype._match
methods.description: Internal method to match parts of the query.

methods.name: FooTable.Query.prototype._left
methods.description: Matches the left side of the query.

methods.name: FooTable.Query.prototype._right
methods.description: Matches the right side of the query.

methods.name: _parse
methods.description: Parses the query string into parts and operators.

methods.name: _part
methods.description: Parses individual query parts into objects for matching.
